title: ENGR 101: Introduction to Engineering
content:
Welcome to Penn Engineering Jan 15 · 1 min read Welcome to ENGR 101, where we explore the fundamentals of engineering design and innovation. This course embodies Penn Engineering’s commitment to Reinventing Invention — preparing the next generation of responsible innovators to expand the frontiers of knowledge.
The spark of ingenuity happens here. Throughout this semester, you’ll engage with transdisciplinary collaboration, hands-on projects, and real-world challenges that define the future of engineering. From robotics to bioengineering, from data science to sustainable systems, we’ll explore how engineers shape our world.
Join us as we embark on a journey powered by collaboration, charged by transformation, and driven by the relentless pursuit of innovation. Together, we’re setting the boundaries of tomorrow by pushing them forward today.
First Lab Session This Week Jan 13 · 0 min read Important: Our first lab session will take place this Thursday in the Detkin Lab. Please bring your Penn Card for access and review the safety guidelines posted on Canvas.
Lab topics will include an introduction to CAD software, 3D printing fundamentals, and basic circuit design. Teams will be formed during this session for the semester project.
Remember to complete the pre-lab assignment and safety training module before attending. Links are available on the course Canvas page.
